## 1. Origami 4 Pour (Joseph)
Brewer: Origami (4 pour). Dose 15g, Water 230g (1:15.3), 92°C, EK43 10.2–10.8. Pours 40g bloom → 70 → 60 → 60. Drawdown 2:30.
Sweetness-focused, balanced, clean; juicy/syrupy, low bitterness, high repeatability. 1:15.3 raises concentration/tactile sweetness; four even pours stabilise slurry temp; moderate agitation reduces channeling; 92°C suppresses bitterness; 2:30 targets moderate extraction favouring sweetness. Temp adjust by coffee (91–95°C). Increase bloom to 45–50g for fresh coffees.

## 2. Samo Bloom (Origami Air S Flatbed)
Dose 20g, Water 300g (1:15.0), 95°C, EK43 10.5. 50g ROOM-TEMP bloom 2:00 outside brewer → transfer slurry to pre-rinsed flatbed → 125g hot → 125g hot at 1:00. Drawdown 2:00.
Hybrid immersion–percolation separating degassing from extraction. Cold external bloom removes CO₂ before brewing → uniform, sweetness-focused cup; 95°C compensates for cool bloom; 20g deep bed improves uniformity; two pours minimise agitation. Best for washed/natural citrus/red-fruit coffees.

## 3. Apartment Coffee (Hario V60 02 Ceramic)
Dose 13g, Water 220g (1:16.9), 93°C, medium-fine (table salt). 40g bloom → 60 → 60 → 60, 20–30s intervals. Drawdown 2:45–3:30. Water GH 75–150 ppm, KH 40–60 ppm. Target TDS 1.30–1.40%, EY 19.39–20.90%.
Clarity-first, moderate extraction, high transparency, tea-like separation. 1:17 dilution distinguishes subtle notes; 40g bloom (3.1×) degasses; three equal pours stable curve; ceramic retains heat; specified hardness supports sweetness+acidity, avoiding flat (soft) or muddy (hard). Judge: QC-grade; ratio/pour/EY alignment classic for clarity.

## 4. Alchemist (Mabelle) — Hario Switch
Dose 15g, Water 245–250g (1:16.3–16.7), 90°C, EK43 10.8. 0:00 bloom 45g → 0:30 to 180g → 1:00 to 245–250g. Drawdown 2:30–3:00.
Low-temp, low-agitation for sweetness/balance, suppressing bitterness & excess acidity. Coarse grind compensates for low temp (flow, avoid over-extraction); 45g bloom (3×); big second pour raises slurry temp; minimal pours reduce agitation/fines. Best washed Colombia/Brazil/Guatemala; chocolate/caramel/brown sugar.

## 5. LUME 4 Pour (Mabelle) — Hario Switch
Dose 15g, Water 235g (1:15.7), 90–92°C, EK43 11.0++. 0:00 bloom 45g → 0:45 to 110 → 1:20 to 210 → 1:30 to 235. Drawdown 2:00–2:30.
Fast-flow, low-agitation; coarse grind + cool temp + short contact → sweetness, clarity, silky texture via efficient percolation not high extraction. Small final 25g pour is a fine extraction adjustment, not a major phase. Judge: efficiency & restraint.

## 6. Roy's Lume Recipe — Hario Switch
Dose 15g, Water 230g (1:15.3), 90–92°C, EK43 9.0–10.0. 0:00–0:30 bloom to 60g (inner bed, slow circular) → 0:30–1:00 to 160g (centre→outer→back) → 1:00–2:15 continuous slow pour to 230g within the bed, avoiding filter walls. Drawdown ~2:15.
Continuous extraction emphasising controlled agitation & POUR PLACEMENT over pour count. 60g bloom (4×) uniform bed; fine-medium grind ups efficiency at low temp; deliberate pour geometry extracts bed regions evenly; long final pour stabilises slurry; avoiding walls minimises bypass. Judge: defining variable is pour geometry, not temp/count.
